Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status at the **preferred** level with two targeted replacements in Section 22.4:

1. Clause (a): our consent-free carve-out now covers Affiliates and successors in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, dropping the $100,000,000 capital-and-surplus qualification, while retaining the Section 21.11 conditions.
2. Clause (b): M&I's "freely assign" right becomes assignable "only with Customer's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer," with M&I's merger/reorganisation/successor limbs left byte-for-byte intact — curing the two previously unmet preferred elements.

The no-Vendor-termination-on-change-of-control element is mapped as already met by Section 21.11.B's obligation to continue Services. Minimality and all official precision checks pass.
